items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: at that time my daddy and Louis were roommates. They lived in the Texas above the boat when they traveled from here to St. Paul. And, um, they became quite friendly.

ctx.x: Yes. He's on that picture with them and St. Cyr, I forget who else was in the band.
And, um, at that time my daddy and Louis were roommates. They lived in the Texas above the boat when they traveled from here to St. Paul. And, um, they became quite friendly.
Well, Baby Dodds was in the band too. Baby Dodds, that's right.
